name: Prestige Mode returns one Prestige riding tome per known riding tier (#10262)
contract: modules/mod-coa-prestige/src/CoAPrestige.cpp's Activate() calls ForgetRiding(), which strips every riding spell the character knows and queues a RidingTomes[] tome per tier, then GrantRewards. Riding spells form one rank chain, so Player::removeSpell on a lower rank also removes every higher rank; ForgetRiding used to decide tier by tier mid-loop, so removing Apprentice first erased Journeyman, Expert and Artisan before the loop reached them, and only the Apprentice tome came back (#10262: 'says 100% riding, only gives 60%'). ForgetRiding now snapshots the known tiers first. The tomes are the 'Riding Tome: <tier> (Prestige)' items from the CoA world package (data/coa-world): 2200037 Apprentice, 1039605 Journeyman, 1046168 Expert, 1052731 Artisan, 2179244 Cold Weather Flying. #10560 had swapped Apprentice, Journeyman and Cold Weather Flying for the Lost Shop 'Soulbound Riding Tome' items 2200034/2200033 and the level-68 stock Tome of Cold Weather Flight 49177, because data/sql has no row for the Prestige tomes; none of those three may be granted. This realm's effective MaxPlayerLevel is 80 (not 60), so the rider fixture must already be at 80 for Chromie to accept the prestige.
